featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie argued that knowledge work will increasingly become "coding-shaped." Because models are improving fastest at coding, tool and computer use, and math, agents that can use software or generate code will advance faster than any other domain of knowledge work. Rather than limiting automation to a small slice of work, more work will reshape itself around what agents are good at — recent releases already show agents producing animated videos, games, and product 3D models via code, while tool use lets…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 写了一段关于「知识工作会变成代码形状」的长思考：模型在编码、工具调用、电脑操作、数学这类任务上进步最快，因此能用软件或直接写代码干活的 Agent，会比其他知识工作领域进化得更快。他认为结果不是「只有一小部分工作能被自动化」，而是越来越多工作会主动「变成代码形状」去适配 Agent 的强项——最近几个月的模型发布里，Agent 已经能用生成代码的方式产出动画视频、游戏、产品 3D 模型；工具调用又让 Agent 能用人类已在用的软件，覆盖网络安全、生命科学、金融等领域。核心判断：模型不必无所不知，真正需要的是「会用/会写软件」+「深度领域知识，能在工作流中做正确判断」，两者结合，几乎一切都会被解锁。

featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared two agent-building workflows. First, with fx + Gemini Argon, two prompts produced a pure Web Components app with no framework, where the agent reused 14 @uisdk behaviors out of the box — window resizing, drag, menubar hover-switching, typeahead, roving toolbar focus, 10-band EQ sliders, scoped hotkeys, ARIA, and WebMCP agent control. Second, he praised fx subagents: all his projects are built by planning with the smartest model and delegating to fast-model subagents, configured wi…
featured.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 晒了两个 Agent 开发实践。一是用 fx + Gemini Argon，两条 prompt 就做出一个纯 Web Components、无框架的应用，Agent 开箱即复用了 @uisdk 的 14 种 UI 行为：窗口缩放、拖拽、菜单栏悬停切换、typeahead、工具栏焦点漫游、10 段均衡器滑块、作用域快捷键、ARIA，以及 WebMCP 的 Agent 控制。二是他盛赞 fx 的 subagents 体验：他所有项目都是「用最聪明的模型做规划 + 把执行委派给快模型 subagent」，而这只需要在 ~/.fx/AGENTS.md 里写一行指令；整个工具只有 6.33MB。

featured.title: Ep 97: Jev Creator on Decision Models, Benchmark Fatigue & Why the Labs Missed It
featured.summaryEn: Jev's founder argues the real bottleneck in AI isn't more intelligence but reliability — most model calls will ultimately be machine-consumed, so the field should shift from benchmark-chasing and novel "task shapes" toward reliability and composability, making intelligence as provider-agnostic as SQL. On Redpoint's Unsupervised Learning, the founder and CEO of Jev (named after Jevons paradox), a former OpenAI researcher, explained that his core question was what share of LLM calls are meant for human consumption versus machine consumption — and that the answer is overwhelmingly machine-native, where computers want discrete decisions rather than strings. Jev positions its models as "System 1" decision models and openly communicates their jaggedness. He asks why AI can solve Millennium Prize-level math but can't automate anything touching accounting, and recalls writing an OpenAI doc titl…
featured.insightZh: Jev 创始人认为 AI 的真正瓶颈不是「更聪明」，而是「可靠」——大部分模型调用最终是给机器消费的，行业应从刷榜和「新任务形态」转向可靠性、可组合性，让 AI 像 SQL 一样与供应商无关。 这一期 Redpoint 的 Unsupervised Learning 请来了 Jev（取名自杰文斯悖论）的创始人兼 CEO（前 OpenAI 研究员，节目转录中名字不清晰）。他的出发点是一个问题：把 LLM 看作被软件调用的子模块，有多少调用是给人看的、有多少是给机器消费的？他认为绝大多数终将是「机器原生」的，计算机要的不是字符串而是离散决策。因此 Jev 定位为「System 1」决策模型，并坦率公开模型弱点（jaggedness）。他抛出一个反问：为什么 AI 能解千禧年数学难题，却自动化不了任何涉及会计的事？他甚至写过一篇内部文档《我们一年前就可以拥有 AGI》，认为 GPT-3.5 时代的智能已足够完成大量简单经济工作，只是没被用起来。 他对「刷榜」极其反感：过度承诺、交付不足会烧掉开发者试用新东西的善意，而竞争对手推出更偏向 benchmark 优化的同类模型，反而在替 Jev「挖护城河」。他批评行业像「WALL-E 里躺在椅子上被投喂 AI 的人」，开发者缺乏主动权；希望大家多向模型方「抱怨」具体的 jaggedness，并希望智能最终像 SQL 一样可靠到供应商无关，开发者不该被锁定在某个模型的「心智模型」里。技术层面，他提出「KV cache 的暴政」：当前 coding agent 的 UX 几乎都围绕只能追加的 KV cache 设计，导致路由、subagent 传上下文、compaction 都受限；他设想多个 Agent 共享读写同一上下文、按新任务做语义化压缩、对历史做廉价 MapReduce 并与同事共享，以及用模型验证自然语言约束的「语义依赖类型」和每次工具调用上的廉价语义安全检查。 商业上，他称 Jev 服务可以盈利运营，融资并非缺钱而是为了引入最有价值的人。谈到 Anthropic 上市，他认为 coding agent 价值巨大但市场可能…

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App VP
items.summaryEn: Google VP Josh Woodward, who leads Google Labs and the Gemini app, announced that Gemini can now connect to Google Wallet for personal finance insights — instant spending charts, spotting sneaky subscription price hikes, and building a holiday budget based on what you actually spent last year. It's rolling out first to all Gemini app users in the US.
items.insightZh: Google VP、负责 Google Labs 与 Gemini App 的 Josh Woodward 宣布 Gemini 新功能：可连接 Google Wallet 获取个人财务洞察——即时生成消费可视化图表、找出悄悄涨价的订阅、基于去年真实支出制定节日预算。首发面向美国所有 Gemini App 用户。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad declared that "Autonomous Businesses are here." He added two observations: technology is inherently recursively self-improving and autonomy has been rising over time — AI is an accelerant, not the start of the cycle, as Douglas Engelbart understood; and we've entered "Murphy's world," where billions of recursively interdependent, accelerating processes mean once-rare failures now happen daily.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 宣称「自主企业（Autonomous Businesses）已经到来」。他还提出两个观察：技术本身就是递归自我改进的，自主程度一直在上升，AI 只是加速器而非起点，Douglas Engelbart 早就理解这一点；以及我们已进入「墨菲世界」——数十亿件事同时发生、递归相互依赖且急速加速，过去罕见的故障如今每天都在发生。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang shared two useful prompts for Fable 5.2: "/doctor prompt-audit" audits your Claude Code setup (CLAUDE.md, skills, commands) and proposes fixes, while "/claude-api prompt-audit [skill name]" audits a single skill in depth. He wishes Claude Code would auto-suggest running these every time Anthropic ships a new model.
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 推荐了两条可用于 Fable 5.2 的实用命令：「/doctor prompt-audit」会审计你的 Claude Code 配置（CLAUDE.md、skills、commands）并给出修复建议；「/claude-api prompt-audit [skill 名]」则对单个 skill 做深度审计。他希望每次 Anthropic 发布新模型时，Claude Code 能自动提示用户跑一遍这些审计。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux, who works on Codex and ChatGPT at OpenAI, asked for feedback on Daybreak on behalf of the cyber team — covering models, Codex plugins, blue/red team access, documentation, red teaming, and the "defense factory" — and what could be improved.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 代网络安全团队征集对 Daybreak 的反馈，涵盖模型、Codex 插件、蓝队/红队访问权限、文档、红队测试与「防御工厂」等方面，询问哪些地方可以做得更好。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper suggested having your agent read Every's "frontier feed," where the company publishes all of its frontier team's AI experiments with raw code and short writeups — in his view the fastest way to get inspired. He also shared a live look at Fable writing an email for him that morning, plus an experiment writeup with code.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 推荐让你的 Agent 去读 Every 的「frontier feed」：他们会公开前沿团队所有 AI 实验，包括原始代码和简短 writeup，他认为这是获取灵感最快的方式。他还分享了 Fable 当天早上帮他写邮件的实况演示，并附上了一篇实验 writeup 与代码。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC President & CEO Garry Tan called Aside Browser a huge unlock for every AI agent and suggested pairing it with his GBrain. He also urged modernizing the FAA, arguing that paper charts, copper wire, and an antiquated, brittle system without enough failsafes — let alone modern software — are not serving Americans properly.
items.insightZh: YC 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 称 Aside Browser 对所有 AI Agent 都是巨大解锁，并推荐与自己的 GBrain 搭配使用。另外他呼吁对 FAA 进行现代化改造：纸质航图、铜线和缺乏足够故障保护、更谈不上现代软件的陈旧脆弱系统，已经无法很好地服务美国民众。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer
items.summaryEn: Swyx of Latent Space and AI Engineer said we are hugely suboptimal in AI UX right now — which is especially striking given that models are now too cheap to meter. He also teased that an upcoming event will include audience participation.
items.insightZh: Latent Space、AI Engineer 主理人 Swyx 认为当前 AI UX 极度不优——尤其在模型已经便宜到「不值得计费」的情况下，这种落后显得很离谱。他还预告了即将到来的活动「会有观众互动环节」。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FirstMark VC and MAD Podcast host Matt Turck endorsed the view that NVIDIA is the one deep-pocketed player with a clear business interest in open-weights AI and a willingness to make founder-style big bets — and asked what happens now.
items.insightZh: FirstMark Capital 投资人、MAD Podcast 主持人 Matt Turck 转发并认同一个观点：NVIDIA 是唯一一个在开源权重 AI 上有明确商业利益、且愿意下创始人式大赌注的财力雄厚玩家，并追问「接下来会怎样？」
